window.vaultCheckout=async()=>{
 if(!cart.length){msg('Your cart is empty.');return}
 if(cart.some(x=>x.previewOnly)){msg('CHECKOUT NOT READY: These are preview sizes, not verified Fourthwall variants. Connect Fourthwall below, then remove preview items and re-add them using live sizes.');$('vault-cart-status').scrollIntoView({block:'nearest',behavior:'smooth'});return}
 
 const b=$('vault-pay');b.disabled=true;msg('Checking each product and size against live inventory…');
 try{
  // Revalidate all cart variants and prices against Fourthwall before requesting payment.
  const products=new Map();
  for(const x of cart){
   if(!x.slug||!x.variantId||x.quantity<1)throw Error('Cart contains an invalid item.');
   if(!products.has(x.slug))products.set(x.slug,await fw('/products/'+encodeURIComponent(x.slug)));
   const product=products.get(x.slug);
   if(product.access?.type&&product.access.type!=='PUBLIC')throw Error(x.name+' is not published yet.');
   if(product.state?.type&&product.state.type!=='AVAILABLE')throw Error(x.name+' is not available for sale.');
   const variant=(product.variants||[]).find(v=>v.id===x.variantId);
   if(!variant||variant.stock?.type==='OUT_OF_STOCK')throw Error(x.name+' / '+x.size+' is unavailable.');
   const livePrice=Number(variant.unitPrice?.value);
   if(Number.isFinite(livePrice)&&Math.abs(livePrice-x.price)>0.009){x.price=livePrice;save();throw Error('A product price changed. Review the updated cart total and tap checkout again.');}
  }
  msg('Creating your secure Fourthwall checkout…');
  const result=await fw('/carts',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({items:cart.map(x=>({variantId:x.variantId,quantity:x.quantity}))})});
  if(!result.id)throw Error('Checkout could not be created.');
  window.location.assign(shop+'/checkout/?cartCurrency=USD&cartId='+encodeURIComponent(result.id));
 }catch(e){msg(e.message);b.disabled=false}
};

async function published(){
 if(publishedProducts)return publishedProducts;
 const list=[];const seen=new Set();
 for(let page=0;page<30;page++){
  const d=await fw('/collections/all/products?size=100&page='+page);
  const batch=listFrom(d);
  for(const item of batch){if(item.slug&&!seen.has(item.slug)){seen.add(item.slug);list.push(item)}}
  if(!d.paging?.hasNextPage || !batch.length)break;
 }
 if(!list.length)throw Error('Fourthwall returned no published products.');

}
function matchOriginal(p,list){
 const names=[p.name,...(originalAliases[p.id]||[])].map(norm);
 const scored=list.map(x=>{
  const n=norm(x.name||x.title),slug=norm(x.slug);
  let score=0;
  for(const term of names){if(n===term)score=Math.max(score,100);else if(n.includes(term)&&term.length>7)score=Math.max(score,70);else if(slug.includes(term)&&term.length>7)score=Math.max(score,65)}
  const orig=norm(p.name).replace(/ t shirt$/,'');
  if(n.includes(orig)&&orig.length>6)score=Math.max(score,90);
  return {item:x,score};
 }).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score);
 return scored[0]?.score>=65?scored[0].item:null;
}

  variants.forEach(v=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=v.id;o.dataset.price=String(v.unitPrice?.value??'');o.dataset.size=v.attributes?.size?.name||v.name||'One size';o.textContent=o.dataset.size+(o.dataset.price?' — '+money(o.dataset.price):'');selector.appendChild(o)});
  const vals=variants.map(v=>Number(v.unitPrice?.value)).filter(Number.isFinite);price.textContent=vals.length?'From '+money(Math.min(...vals)):'Price unavailable';
  status.textContent='Published on Fourthwall · '+(match.name||match.title)+' · Select size to add to THE VAULT cart.';
  selector.onchange=()=>{add.disabled=!selector.value};
  add.onclick=()=>{
   const v=variants.find(v=>v.id===selector.value);if(!v)return;
   const livePrice=Number(v.unitPrice?.value);if(!Number.isFinite(livePrice)){status.textContent='Live price could not be verified. Cannot add to cart.';return}
   const existing=cart.find(x=>x.variantId===v.id);if(existing)existing.quantity++;
   else cart.push({variantId:v.id,slug,previewOnly:false,name:match.name||match.title||p.name,size:v.attributes?.size?.name||v.name||'One size',price:livePrice,quantity:1,image:p.mockup||p.image});
   save();d.remove();showCart();msg('Added to THE VAULT cart.');
  };
 }catch(err){price.textContent='Live price unavailable';status.textContent='Cannot verify this published product: '+err.message;selector.style.display='none';add.disabled=true}
};

const trigger=document.createElement('button');trigger.id='vault-cart-launch';trigger.type='button';trigger.innerHTML='🛒 CART · <span id="vault-cart-count">0</span>';trigger.addEventListener('click',showCart);document.body.appendChild(trigger);
const dlg=document.createElement('dialog');dlg.id='vault-cart-dialog';dlg.innerHTML='<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center"><h2>THE VAULT · YOUR CART</h2><button type="button" class="x" id="vault-close-cart">×</button></div><p class="vault-commerce-status">Review your sizes and adjust quantities below.</p><div id="vault-cart-lines"></div><p style="text-align:right"><strong>Subtotal: <span id="vault-cart-total">$0.00</span></strong></p><p class="vault-commerce-status">Only verified published Fourthwall variants can proceed to payment. Shipping and taxes are calculated at checkout.</p><p id="vault-cart-status" class="vault-commerce-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" style="padding:12px;border-left:3px solid #d4b879;color:#f5e3b6"></p><button type="button" id="vault-pay" class="btnacid">SECURE CHECKOUT</button>';document.body.appendChild(dlg);
$('vault-close-cart').addEventListener('click',()=>dlg.close());$('vault-pay').addEventListener('click',window.vaultCheckout);renderCart();
})();
</script></body></html>
